construction_details: Backpack, 600D polyester body. Main zip: approved #8 coil zip, chain marking per approved zip; slider lug 1.4 mm; puller riveted to slider lug; zip tape bar-tacked twice at top stop. Double-stitched seams at all stress points.
test_requirements: Zip pull strength >= 140 N (TMT-0005); Seam strength >= 95 N (TMT-0006); Colourfastness to rubbing grade >= 4 (TMT-0001)
notes: Backpack. Critical: zip must hold 140 N before failure; zip supplier and chain marking must not change without approval.

construction_details: Technical jacket, 3-layer polyester shell. Thread: water-resistant bonded nylon thread. Stitching: lockstitch 12 stitches per inch. All main seams taped 20 mm, including shoulder seams; reinforced shoulder attachment points.
water_resistance_spec: Hydrostatic head >= 1000 mm; spray rating >= 80; all main seams taped
test_requirements: Seam strength >= 110 N (TMT-0006); Spray rating >= 80 (TMT-0007); Hydrostatic head >= 1000 mm (TMT-0009); Tear strength >= 18 N (TMT-0004)
notes: Technical jacket must resist heavy rain. Seams are critical for water resistance.
